blocks.text: An achievement: world.config.yaml achievements.<milestone name>. Spawn lists it on the game's page with the share of players who hold it; ctx.emit("milestone", { name }) with that name unlocks it for the player in a published release that lists it, the maker too; the editing copy never unlocks…

AchievementDef = { name: string // The name players see: 1 to 40 characters description: string // The whole feat: 1 to 100 characters hidden?: boolean // The name, description and trophy show only to players who hold it trophy?: string // Its trophy file, "trophies/<name>.json" (TrophyFile); none shows Spawn's plain star }
